consumes.B: INTERFACE_B B.1 @6a77d424: fit_id / search_candidate formulas adopted verbatim; E is the single source of the functions that compute them.

modules.plan: tools.i6n_search_plan (plan JSON, seal, budgets, promotion, fold fitness, per-horizon search state, finalists, fit specs, CLI)
modules.shared_plugin: optimizer_plugins.i6n_optimizer.Plugin: v2 path when opt_config has i6n_plan; v1 path (legacy) unchanged otherwise

domain.delta_x_hours: integer divisors common to h and L, incl. 1 (delta_x_domain(h,L))
domain.n_samples: 1 + L/dx, includes t; offsets -L..0 step dx
domain.trajectory_k: k in [2,3,4] with h % k == 0; dy = h/k; outputs [dy,2dy,...,h]; endpoint == k=1 -> canonical endpoint with trajectory_k=null
domain.transformer_blocks: 0 for conv (inactive, canonicalized); 1|2 for transformer routes
domain.reducer_strides: list with one value in [1,2] per reducer (len == len(reducer_filters)), right-anchored; rejected only if steps end below min_final_steps (t is always kept)
domain.stride_label: derived.stride_pattern in {none, progressive, final, mixed}; labels/seeds only (one reducer [2] is 'final')

genotype.canonicalizer: tools.i6n_search_space.canonicalize(raw) -> canonical | raise Infeasible(reasons=[{code,gene,detail}]); check(raw) is the non-raising form. Never repairs active genes.

evaluator_boundary.to_evaluator_genome: tools.i6n_search_space.to_evaluator_genome(g) -> v1 genome {horizon, multiplier(min equivalent), delta_x, input_transform, output_mode, delta_y, core}
evaluator_boundary.tools/i6n_search.py: FROZEN byte-identical (legacy identity source); do not edit

identities.genotype_canonical_sha256: tools.i6n_search_space.genotype_sha256(g) == tools.i6n_search.effective_identity(to_evaluator_genome(g)). Same value as A's receipt field and B's assumption; in-domain legacy candidates keep their v1 identity.
identities.effective_config_sha256: tools.i6n_search_space.effective_config_sha256(g) = sha256(json.dumps(evaluator_config(g), sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')). A must emit exactly this in candidate_receipt.effective_config_sha256.
identities.fit_id: tools.i6n_search_space.fit_id(g, {experiment, fold_id, context_sha256, support_sha256}) = sha256(canonical {experiment, fold, effective_config_sha256, context_sha256, support_sha256}) (B.1 formula, plan independent). The seed and stopping rule live in the context (A's cell training block).

effective_config_record: tools.i6n_search_space.effective_config(g) -> {schema: i6n.effective_config.v2, genotype, genotype_canonical_sha256, effective_config_sha256, active_genes, inactive_genes, derived{history_hours, delta_x_hours, n_samples, input_offsets_hours, delta_y_hours, output_offsets_hours, n_heads, reducer_strides, steps_per_stage, final_steps, t_retained}, model_core, size_class, evaluator_genome, evaluator_config}
class_rule: class_of(g): first class with n_samples<=max_samples, max(width, reducers, adapter_width)<=max_width and dx>=min_delta_x_hours

seeds.seed_genotype(h): Conv8 -> Conv4, reducer_strides [1], no Transformer/LSTM, identity input, endpoint; smallest history with a downsampled S1 grid, finest such dx
seeds.alternative_genotype(h): Conv16 -> Conv8 -> Conv4, reducer_strides [1,1], same window (small, non-equivalent, not Transformer)

shared_wire_v2.fields: {schema, genotype (v2), genome (v1 evaluator genome), identity (= genotype_canonical_sha256), context (sha256 of plan contract), generation[, fitness]}
shared_wire_v2.note: B may keep using wire.genome with tools.i6n_search for result binding; hyper_dict == evaluator_config(genotype)

keys.plan_sha256: == seal.sha256; sha256 of canonical plan without the keys plan_sha256 and seal
keys.domain: as genotype.domain, per-horizon history and k domains expanded
keys.classes: [{class_id, max_samples, max_width, min_delta_x_hours, child_memory_bytes: null, child_wall_seconds: null, admission: FROM_ADMITTED_COST_PILOT_RECEIPT}] (measured caps are NOT sealed in the plan; they come from pilot receipts with cap = 1.25*measured peak)
keys.promotion: [{class_id, opens_at_generation: S1 0 | S2 1 | S3 2, requires: [admitted_cost_pilot, previous generation terminal on all folds]}]
keys.folds: {fold_ids: [2023Q1..2023Q4], rule, inner_days 28, train_calendar_years 4, purged, distinct_periods true, all_folds_required_before_ranking true, definition_owner C}
keys.search: {population_size 8, generations 3, new_candidates_per_horizon 24, mutation 0.8, immigration 0.2, crossover false, selection, tolerance 1e-4, patience 3, direction minimize}
keys.fitness: {per_fold: 0.5*(sum_abs_error_TRAIN/naive_sum_abs_error_TRAIN + sum_abs_error_INNER/naive_sum_abs_error_INNER) on endpoint h, aggregation: unweighted mean over the 4 folds, using tools.i6n_search._score per fold}
keys.budgets: {new_candidates_per_horizon_max 24, folds_per_candidate 4, new_fits_per_horizon_max 96, total_new_fits_max 1152, per_class_new_candidates_per_horizon_max {S1 24, S2 16, S3 8}, per_class_new_candidates_total_max, max_physical_attempts_per_identity_fold 3, cache_hits_count_as_new_fits false, oom_retry_with_lower_cap false}
keys.finalists: best complete fitness + minimal control (seed), or small alternative when the seed is best/unavailable
keys.weekly_rollout: finalist arms rolled out with weekly refit; recipe transfer is NOT claimed optimal
keys.prior_mapping: {artifact: docs/i6n/swarm/E_LEGACY_MAPPING_v1.json, sha256, verdict}: 48/48 MAPPED with their own v1 identity, fold_score_reuse NONE, no refit
